text:
Ava (Finance): Heads up — EdgeOps prepaid invoice allocated to the wrong revenue schedule for Jan month-end. looks like it hit ARR instead of prepaid deferrals. can we fix before close?
Miguel (RevRec): ugh. invoice #EO-4821? amount? do we have supporting usage split / contract terms? :thinking_face:
Ava (Finance): correct invoice EO-4821, total $96,000 annual prepay booked 2026-01-12. Customer signed a 12-month prepaid voucher but the contract states recognition monthly over service term. billing system created a single ARR line by mistake.
Priya (Billing): tagging @Jamal (Ops) — billing export shows one invoice_line: 
```
line_id: 99821
description: EdgeOps - Prepaid 12mo
quantity: 1
amount: 96000
rev_scope: ARR
```
We need it as 12 monthly deferrals (96000/12 = 8000/mo).
Jamal (Ops): I can re-export adj file but need to know GL & rev schedule mapping. who owns journal?
Miguel (RevRec): Rev schedule should be "PREPAY_12M_EDGEOPS" and GL mapping: 
- Debit: Cash/AR 96000
- Credit: Deferred Revenue 96000
Then monthly recognition JE: 
```
Debit: Deferred Revenue 8000
Credit: Revenue - Subscriptions 8000
```
We must reverse the erroneous ARR booking: find the recurring ARR booking entry and zero it out.
Ava (Finance): I'll open a ticket with accounting ops to reverse ARR posting and create deferral schedule. Do we need a management approval note?
Miguel (RevRec): Yes — for audit trail add approval: Finance Head (Ava) + RevRec (Miguel). Also ask Billing (Priya) to confirm export file with corrected rev_scope so we can re-run revenue engine.
Priya (Billing): Will push correction to billing export this afternoon. I'll attach the corrected CSV and include a comment in the invoice record: "rev_scope corrected to PREPAY_12M_EDGEOPS — 2026-01-25".
InvoiceBot: Payment processed for EO-4821 on 2026-01-12 (txn_0b9c).
Ava (Finance): For month-end checklist: can we get the reversal journal and new deferral JE posted by EOD 2026-01-25 so close isn't blocked? 
Jamal (Ops): I'll schedule the GL adj for tonight's batch. tagging @Priya — please confirm when corrected export is in S3 (s3://billing-exports/jan/EO-4821-corrected.csv).
Priya (Billing): uploaded to S3 and left note in invoice record. file path: s3://billing-exports/jan/EO-4821-corrected.csv :white_check_mark:
Miguel (RevRec): once posted I'll validate revenue schedule and update revrec dashboard. pls ping when JE number is available.
Ava (Finance): JE posted: reversal 2026-01-25 JE# 560211 (Credit Revenue ARR 96000 / Debit Suspense 96000), new deferral JE# 560212 (Credit Deferred Revenue 96000 / Debit Suspense 96000). Miguel — can you ok and I'll close the loop?
Miguel (RevRec): reviewed and approved. schedule shows PREPAY_12M_EDGEOPS with monthly recognition starting 2026-01-31. :thumbsup:
Ava (Finance): perfect. closing out. I'll add notes to month-end binder and record approvals. thanks team.
Jamal (Ops): leaving a quick follow-up reminder: we should add a validation rule in the billing pipeline to prevent system-only ARR mapping for prepaid SKUs. filing a small engineering request.
Priya (Billing): +1 to validation rule. filing a billing-run checklist item.
Ava (Finance): great — ticket and owners please. closing thread.
